checks: Visible Grab attaches a real native constraint to the dynamic Block at tick zero without moving the authored scene
Lift visibly advances intermediate native solver ticks; the actual body reaches +0.5 m within 0.08 m and stays dynamic/held
Release removes the constraint, preserves velocity, advances 120 real gravity/contact ticks and records an intervention rather than a frictionless-reference pass
Manipulation changes live physics while authored geometry and scene version remain unchanged
Run JSON retains exact native samples/commands and CSV retains actual coordinates/ticks; both saved files match independent SHA-256
Actual exported VP8 WebM decodes at 960×540, contains visible native block pixels, plays to completion and matches the source tick range/duration
Native replay re-executes recorded grab/move/release commands and reproduces final position within 0.0001 m
Choosing a scene file only previews it; explicit import creates fresh identities with equivalent native geometry and provenance
The same typed agent tools duplicate supported scenes and reject executable/unknown import fields before any new scene is created
No renderer errors; all operations use isolated private test data and leave authored/user projects intact

manipulationEvaluation.forceContract: 300 N equivalent per-axis impulse clamp; other contact/gravity forces remain active

solverConfiguration.friction: block coefficient multiplied by static-surface coefficient 1

scope: Real native point-to-point constraint over the supported dynamic Block; virtual reach, not a physical avatar/robot. Scene import supports the native ramp/block schema; arbitrary meshes, documents, videos and executable code are not imported as physics.
